doc.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Joining Blue Mitchell's band
summary: Corea gets the piano chair in Blue Mitchell's group, having loved Blowin' The Blues Away.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: But then you wind up in Blue Mitchell’s, a gig you would have been as well qualified for as anybody, having transcribed so many of his solos.

Well, look at the fortuitousness of that, which is me in love with that band, Blowin’ The Blues Away. There’s that band, and when Horace wasn’t doing Horace Silver Quintet gigs, Blue would take the group and do gigs. He needed a piano player. I still can’t remember how I got that gig, but I ended up in that piano chair, and did some recordings, and played gloriously with that band. It was a great experience for me.
